feature: Add frosted-glass backdrop to floating recorder bar
description: Add a frosted-glass panel behind the recorder bar to create clear visual separation between the recording controls and scrolling history content beneath them. This is a CSS-only change to the existing .recorder-bar element plus minor cleanup of redundant child styles.
risk_assessment: Low risk — CSS-only changes to a single file. No JavaScript, HTML structure, or functionality changes. The frosted-glass pattern (backdrop-filter + rgba background) is already used by .status-text in this codebase, confirming browser compatibility intent. backdrop-filter has broad support (Chrome 76+, Safari 9+, Firefox 103+, Edge 79+).

phases.name: Add frosted-glass backdrop to recorder bar
phases.description: Apply frosted-glass background, padding, border-radius, and shadow to the .recorder-bar container so all its children sit on a unified translucent panel. Then clean up the now-redundant frosted-glass styling on .status-text and ensure mobile responsiveness.

subtasks.title: Add frosted-glass background and panel styling to .recorder-bar
subtasks.description:
In public/css/style.css, update the .recorder-bar rule (line ~218) to add frosted-glass panel properties while keeping all existing positioning intact:

ADD these properties:
- background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75)
- -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px)
- backdrop-filter: blur(16px)
- border-radius: 20px
- padding: 12px 20px
- border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)
- box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)

KEEP unchanged:
- position: fixed
- bottom: 48px
- left: 50%
- transform: translateX(-50%)
- display: flex
- flex-direction: column
- align-items: center
- gap: 6px
- z-index: 20
subtasks.notes: Added frosted-glass properties to .recorder-bar: translucent background, backdrop blur(16px), border-radius 20px, padding 12px 20px, subtle white border, and soft box-shadow. All existing positioning properties preserved. Committed as 31ea23b.

subtasks.title: Simplify .status-text to remove redundant frosted-glass
subtasks.description:
In public/css/style.css, update .status-text (line ~422) to remove its own background and backdrop-filter since these are now provided by the parent .recorder-bar panel:

CHANGE:
- background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9) → remove this property entirely
- backdrop-filter: blur(4px) → remove this property entirely

KEEP unchanged:
- color: var(--text-secondary)
- font-size: 0.75rem
- padding: 2px 10px
- border-radius: 12px
subtasks.notes: Removed background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9) and backdrop-filter: blur(4px) from .status-text. Kept color, font-size, padding, and border-radius unchanged. These visual effects are now inherited from the parent .recorder-bar panel.

subtasks.title: Add mobile responsiveness for the panel
subtasks.description:
In public/css/style.css, add responsive adjustments inside the existing @media (max-width: 480px) block (line ~671):

ADD a .recorder-bar rule:
- padding: 10px 14px
- border-radius: 16px

Also add max-width: calc(100vw - 24px) to the BASE .recorder-bar rule (subtask 1.1) to prevent the panel from overflowing on narrow viewports.
subtasks.notes: Added max-width: calc(100vw - 24px) to base .recorder-bar rule to prevent panel overflow on narrow viewports. Added responsive .recorder-bar rule inside @media (max-width: 480px) with padding: 10px 14px and border-radius: 16px. Changes verified in diff. Awaiting git commit approval.

subtasks.title: Verify hover/active transforms on child buttons
subtasks.description: Verification-only subtask. Confirm that .mic-btn:hover (transform: scale(1.05)) and .mic-btn:active (transform: scale(0.95)) still work correctly since these are on child elements — they should not conflict with the parent's translateX(-50%). No code changes expected unless a visual issue is found.
subtasks.notes: Verified: .mic-btn:hover (scale 1.05) and .mic-btn:active (scale 0.95) are on child elements, completely independent of the parent .recorder-bar's translateX(-50%). CSS transform is not inherited — parent and child transforms operate in separate coordinate spaces. No conflicts, no code changes needed. All button variants (translate-btn, prompt-btn, clean-btn) confirmed safe.

final_acceptance: Frosted-glass panel visible behind recorder bar on desktop and mobile
Scrolling history content is visually separated from recorder controls
Button hover/active states still work correctly
Panel does not overflow viewport on narrow screens
No JavaScript or HTML changes required
